objective: Add explicit owner-triggered image understanding to the M08 perception spine by reusing the pinned Qwen3.5-4B Ollama brain, retaining no pixels and storing only a bounded untrusted summary inside the existing maximum-15-second observation.
non_goals: Do not capture continuously or without the browser display picker/explicit upload action.
Do not add a second VLM, OCR dependency, autonomous tool action or automatic memory write.
Do not persist snapshot pixels, base64 images or model prompts.
Do not promote Qwen3.5-9B without a measured all-on VRAM benchmark below 14336 MiB.
contracts: Vision is available only on an explicit perception.observe request after the existing feature and capability checks pass.
The Ollama request is bounded, uses the pinned local Qwen3.5 model, shares the model scheduler, and sets keep_alive=0.
No PNG bytes or base64 survive request completion; only bounded untrusted text is attached to the TTL observation.
Vision output is decisionSupportEligible=false and cannot invoke tools or enter memory automatically.
A VLM error preserves the non-visual snapshot evidence and returns a stable visible error state.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Python standard library, Hina text-brain gateway, scheduler and Ollama HTTP API; no new package or model dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Provider and gateway tests cover image encoding, response extraction, empty/error response, scheduler lease and deterministic unload.
Perception tests prove summary bounds, no pixel retention, TTL preservation, explicit opt-in and visible error state.
The Quan sat dashboard lets a non-developer request local image analysis, ask a bounded question and understand the privacy/TTL behavior.
A real local Qwen3.5-4B screenshot smoke returns Vietnamese text while Ollama reports 100% GPU execution.
